<reason>PRO won the burden and irreversibility clash. Requiring acceptance of adequacy vs completing paperwork, plus diffusion cannot be undone, survived CON's delay and foreign-availability attacks. PRO's symmetry reply — withdrawal fails abroad too — and concrete material-upgrade plus 30-day bounded review with continued use neutralized the queue and two-tier charges enough that bounded wait outweighed ex-post enforcement.</reason>
